caption: An ice cream cone stands in a holder on a sunny picnic table, and the ice cream is melting and dripping down the side of the cone.
Hot water is poured from a kettle over a large block of ice on the ground, and the ice melts where the water hits it.
A pat of cold butter is dropped into a hot frying pan, and it melts into a spreading pool of liquid.
A pat of butter on a small plate is heated in a microwave and slowly melts.
A skateboarder riding along a sidewalk hits a raised crack, the board stops dead, and the rider is thrown forward off the board.
A family sits in the back seat of a car as it takes a sharp bend on a country road, and all of them lean toward the outside of the bend.
A woman standing in the aisle of a bus holding the overhead rail sways backward as the bus pulls away from the stop.
A woman is jogging on a treadmill when the belt stops abruptly, and she lurches forward and grabs the handrails.
A ceiling fan running at full speed is switched off at the wall, and the blades keep turning for a while before coming to a stop.
A full cup of coffee sits in the cup holder of a car, and as the car turns sharply left the coffee sloshes up the right side of the cup and spills over the rim.
A boy takes a short run-up on a field, leaps forward off one foot, and after landing on both feet takes a few stumbling steps forward before he stops.
Autumn leaves come loose from a tree on a still afternoon and drift down to settle on the lawn.
A spinning top is set going on a wooden table and left alone; it spins for a while, starts to wobble, and finally topples over.
A cat nudges a pen off the edge of a desk with its paw and the pen falls to the floor.
A picture frame hanging on a wall comes loose from its nail and falls to the floor.
A car in a parking lot rolls slowly forward, bumps into the back of a parked car, and stops.
A hockey puck slides along the ice, hits the metal goalpost, and deflects off at an angle.
A white cue ball rolls straight into a red ball sitting still on a pool table; the red ball rolls away and the cue ball stops.
A bowling ball reaches the end of the lane, hits the front pin of a full rack, and the pins fly and scatter.
A curling stone glides down the ice, strikes another stone sitting in the house, and knocks it away while itself slowing to a stop.
A skydiver steps out of the open door of an airplane and drops away below it.
A diver stands at the end of a high platform, bends her knees, jumps off, and falls into the pool.
A shopping cart rolls across a parking lot, runs into a concrete curb, and stops abruptly.
A finger tips over the first domino in a long row standing on a table, and the whole row falls one after another.
A basketball thrown from the free-throw line hits the front of the rim, bounces up, and falls to the floor.
Two passengers sit in the back seat of a car when it brakes hard, and both are thrown forward against their seat belts.
A shopping cart is given a push across an empty parking lot and let go, and it rolls on by itself until it slows to a stop.
An empty playground swing is given one push and left alone, and it keeps going back and forth on its own before gradually dying down.
A phone lying flat on the dashboard of a car slides forward toward the windshield when the car brakes suddenly at a red light.
A serving cart carrying a tray of full water glasses is pushed forward and stopped short, and the water sloshes forward and spills.
A wagon loaded with pumpkins is pulled along a path by its handle and the pull stops suddenly; the wagon rolls on a little and the pumpkins tip forward.
A bowling ball is released at the top of the lane and rolls the full length of the lane to the pins at the far end.
A car driving along an icy street brakes hard, its wheels lock, and it slides on past the stop line before it comes to a halt.
A wet umbrella is flicked sharply and stopped short, and the water drops fly off the tip and keep going in the direction of the flick.
A bag of oranges tips over at the top of a staircase, and the oranges spill out and tumble down the stairs to the bottom.
A hammer resting on the top of a ladder is knocked off and falls to the ground.
The string of a helium balloon tied to a park bench comes loose, and the balloon floats up into the sky.
A ceramic plate slides off the edge of a restaurant counter, drops onto the tiled floor, and shatters.
A tennis ball is tossed straight up in a backyard and comes back down to the same spot.
A stack of coins on the corner of a kitchen counter is knocked off by an elbow and the coins scatter on the floor.
An egg is cracked on the rim of a bowl and the shell pulled apart above it, and the yolk and white drop into the bowl.
A water balloon is dropped from a second-floor balcony, and it falls straight down and bursts on the pavement.
A button on a vending machine is pressed, and a can drops inside the machine and lands in the tray at the bottom.
Two bumper cars at a fairground drive straight at each other, meet head-on, and both cars bounce back a little.
A tennis ball is thrown hard against a brick wall and bounces back the way it came.
A dodgeball thrown hard hits a heavy punching bag hanging in a gym, bounces off it, and drops to the floor.
A toy train runs along a track, hits a wooden block lying across the rails, and stops.
A putted golf ball rolls across the green, hits the back of the cup's rim, pops up, and drops into the hole.
A soccer ball rolled at a slant into a low garden wall bounces off at a slant the other way and rolls on across the lawn.
A soccer ball rolled across a paved yard hits an empty plastic bucket standing in its path; the bucket is knocked over and the ball rolls on more slowly.
A frozen fish fillet is laid in a hot pan, and the white frost on its surface disappears as the fillet thaws.
A saucepan of water on high heat is at a rolling boil, with large bubbles bursting at the surface.
Steam rises from a manhole cover on a city street on a cold morning.
A pot of pasta water boils over on a stove, and foamy water spills down the outside of the pot onto the burner.
Noodles cook in a pot of boiling water, bobbing and swirling with the bubbles.
Icicles hanging from a roof gutter drip steadily in the afternoon sun.
A candle tips and a drop of liquid wax falls onto a wooden table, where it hardens into a small white disc.
Eggs boil in a pot on a stove, rattling against each other as the water bubbles around them.
A pressure cooker on a stove starts hissing, and a jet of steam shoots up from the valve on its lid.
Water boils in a glass electric kettle, with streams of bubbles rising from the bottom to the surface.
A pot of soup simmers on a stove, with small bubbles breaking the surface and steam rising.
A bowl of half-melted chocolate sits in a pan of steaming water and is stirred with a spatula, and the remaining pieces melt into the liquid.
A glowing red-hot metal ball is set on top of a large block of ice, and the ice melts around it.
A fruit popsicle stands upright on its stick in a cup on a sunny table, and it drips down the stick.
An ice cube is dropped into a mug of hot tea, and it melts quickly.
A candle burns on a dinner table, and melted wax spills over the rim and runs down one side.
A marshmallow on a stick is propped over a campfire, and it puffs, softens and sags.
An ice cube is flicked onto a hot skillet, and it skitters around and shrinks as it melts.
A handful of shredded cheese is scattered onto a hot skillet, and the shreds melt and flow together into a bubbling layer.
A cube of cold butter is dropped into a bowl of hot soup, and the butter melts and spreads across the surface.
A small snowball is set on a hot griddle, and it hisses and collapses into water and steam.
Warm chocolate sauce is poured over a scoop of ice cream, and the sauce firms into a crackly shell on the cold surface.
A bead of hot glue is squeezed from a glue gun onto a piece of wood, a button is pressed into it, and the glue sets hard around the button.
Boiling sugar syrup is drizzled from a spoon into a bowl of ice water, and the syrup hardens instantly into brittle golden threads.
A hairdryer is aimed at crayons taped to the top of a canvas, and the crayons melt and run down the canvas in coloured streaks that harden lower down.
Hot caramel is poured onto a cold marble slab, and the caramel spreads, then stiffens into a glassy sheet.
Melted butter is poured onto a plate that has just come out of the freezer, and the butter turns cloudy and firm on the plate.
On a bitterly cold winter morning a cup of water is splashed onto a frozen car windshield, and the water freezes into a film of ice on the glass.
Hot bacon fat is poured into a glass jar straight from the fridge, and the fat begins to set where it touches the cold glass.
A bag of frozen peas is emptied into a pot of hot water, and the frost on them vanishes and the clumps break apart.
A wax crayon lies on a hot skillet, and it softens, slumps, and melts into a coloured pool.
A block of frozen orange juice is dropped into a jug of hot water, and it melts, the orange colour spreading into the water.
A spoonful of solid white coconut oil is dropped into a hot frying pan, and it melts into clear liquid.
A wedge of cheese sits under the heating element of a raclette grill, and the face nearest the element softens, sags and drips.
Warm water is poured over a frosted car windshield on a cold morning, and the frost clears where the water runs.
A handful of chocolate chips is dropped into a saucepan of hot cream, and the chips melt into the cream.
A square of chocolate lies in a skillet over low heat, and it melts into a spreading pool.
Hot espresso is poured over a scoop of vanilla ice cream in a glass, and the ice cream melts.
A kettle on a stove is at the boil, steam pours from the spout, and the lid rattles.
The lid is lifted off a rice cooker, and a cloud of steam billows up out of it.
A steam wand is pushed into a jug of milk, and the milk hisses, swirls, and rises in the jug as foam.
A steam iron is pressed onto a shirt on an ironing board, and puffs of steam rise from around the iron.
Boiling water is poured from a kettle into a mug, and steam rises from the mug as it fills.
A divided hot pot with spicy red oil broth on one side and clear broth on the other heats over a burner, and the red side comes to the boil while the clear side stays calm.
A wooden puppet hanging in a sunny window lifts one arm as its string is pulled, and its shadow on the wall lifts its arm too.
A riderless skateboard rolls past a streetlamp at night, and its shadow swings around it as it passes under the light.
A dog runs across a sunlit lawn, and its shadow runs along the grass beside it.
A desk lamp is moved from the left side of a vase to the right side, and the vase's shadow swings from the right side of the vase to the left.
A pair of hands held in a flashlight beam pointed at a wall forms a bird shape, and a bird-shaped shadow appears on the wall.
A balloon drifts across the beam of a projector during a slideshow, and its dark silhouette appears on the screen over the slides.
A tall wooden lifeguard chair stands on a beach with the low sun behind it, and its long shadow stretches across the sand in front of it.
A flashlight is brought closer to a toy dinosaur standing in front of a wall, and the dinosaur's shadow on the wall grows larger.
The shadow of a cloud sweeps across a sunlit hillside, darkening the grass as it passes.
A frog jumps straight up from a sunlit stone, and its shadow stays on the stone and separates from its feet while it is in the air.
A tractor drives along a sunlit field track, and its shadow rolls along the ground beside it.
A ball is thrown across a sunlit yard, and the ball's shadow slides along the ground beneath it and meets the ball where it lands.
A patio umbrella is opened in the sun, and a round shadow appears on the ground beneath it.
A car drives under a highway bridge on a sunny day, and its shadow disappears in the bridge's shade and reappears on the far side.
A ball rolls from a sunlit pavement into the shade of a building, and its shadow disappears.
A lit candle is carried in a circle around a vase on a table, and the vase's shadow sweeps around the table opposite the candle.
A flock of birds flies over a sunlit field, and their shadows race across the grass below them.
A kite flies high over a beach in the sun, and its small shadow moves across the sand as the kite sways.
A ball rolls through the shadow of a signpost on a sunny pavement, and the post's shadow slides over the ball as it passes.
A parked bicycle is lit from behind by a car's headlights at night, and a long shadow of the bicycle stretches down the road ahead of it.
A hand reaches across a table toward a lamp, and the shadow of the arm sweeps across the table on the far side of the lamp from the arm.
A ceiling fan is switched on under a bright bulb, and the spinning blades throw moving shadows across the room.
A ball bounces on a sunny court, and its shadow on the ground meets the ball at each bounce and separates as it rises.
An empty swing sways in the afternoon sun, and its shadow swings back and forth across the ground.
A drone hovers over a sunlit parking lot and then flies to one side, and its small shadow on the asphalt moves with it.
A pigeon lands on a sunny square, and as it touches down its shadow on the paving joins it at its feet.
The curtains of a sunny window are pulled open, and the shadow of the window frame appears on the floor.
A hand is held in front of a projector lens, and a dark hand shape covers part of the picture on the screen.
A fox trots toward a streetlamp at night, and its shadow behind it shrinks until it is directly under the light.
A flag flutters on a pole in the sun, and its shadow flutters on the wall behind it.
A cat walks along a sunlit windowsill inside a house, and its shadow moves across the floor of the room.
A book is held up between a lamp and a wall, and a rectangular shadow appears on the wall; as the book is tilted the shadow narrows.
A robot vacuum travels the length of a corridor lit by a single ceiling light, and its shadow on the floor changes side as it passes beneath the light.
A remote-controlled car launches off a small ramp in the sun, and its shadow stays on the ground while it is airborne and rejoins it on landing.
A toy car is lifted off a sunlit table, and its shadow stays on the table and grows fainter as the car is raised higher.
A garden hose sprays an arc of water in the evening sun, and the shadow of the arc falls on the soil beside it.
Two lamps light a statue on a table from different sides, and the statue casts two shadows in different directions.
A park bench stands beside a wall at dusk as the streetlights come on, and a shadow of the bench appears on the wall away from the nearest light.
A horse trots across a sunlit paddock, and its shadow trots along the grass beside it, legs moving in step.
A pendulum swings in front of a wall lit by a lamp, and its shadow on the wall swings with it.
A dog walks between a campfire and a tent at night, and a huge shadow of the dog sweeps across the tent wall.
A bus passes a row of parked cars on a sunny street, and its shadow slides over the cars one after another.
A leaf is held up against the sun, and its shadow falls on the ground below.
A car drives along a road with the morning sun on its left, and its shadow runs along the ground on its right.
A tree sways in the wind on a sunny day, and the pattern of leaf shadows on the ground beneath it shifts and dances.
A lamppost on a pier casts its shadow onto the water below, and the shadow rides the ripples.
A cat walks along the base of a sunlit wall, and its shadow walks along the wall beside it.
A lantern inside a tent is turned up to full brightness, and sharp shadows of the tent poles appear on the canvas.
The wall switch in a dark hallway is flipped up, and the ceiling light comes on.
The wall switch in a lit hallway is flipped down, and the ceiling light goes off.
The power button on a remote pointed at a television is pressed, and the screen lights up.
The headlight knob on a car's dashboard is turned, and the headlights come on and the dashboard dials light up.
A glowing bulb is unscrewed from a table lamp, and it goes dark as it comes loose.
An old bulb in a ceiling fixture flashes bright for an instant and then goes dark for good.
A string of fairy lights is plugged into a wall socket, and the whole string lights up along its length.
The button on an electric kettle is pressed, and a small light on the kettle comes on and the switch stays down.
The knob of a night light in a dark bedroom is turned, and the little lamp glows.
A power strip with four lamps plugged into it is switched on, and all four lamps come on at once.
The power button on a laptop is pressed, and the screen lights up and the keyboard glows.
A light switch is flicked up and down several times in quick succession, and the ceiling light goes on and off in step with each flick.
The call button beside an elevator is pressed, and the button lights up.
The light chain on a ceiling fan is pulled, and the light above the fan comes on while the blades stay still.
The button on an electric toothbrush lying on a counter is pressed, and the head starts buzzing and vibrating.
The button on a garage door remote is pressed, and the garage light comes on and the door begins to rise.
A neon shop sign is switched on, and the tubes flicker and then glow steadily.
A microwave door is opened, and the light inside the microwave comes on.
A traffic light at a quiet crossing changes from red to green, and the red lamp goes dark as the green lamp lights.
A string of Christmas lights wound around a tree is switched on, and the tree lights up from the plug to the top all at once.
The button on a bicycle's rear light is pressed, and it begins to blink red.
The green start button on a conveyor belt is pressed, and the belt begins to move.
The key in a car's ignition is turned, and the dashboard lights up before the engine starts.
A fingertip holds down the doorbell button beside a front door, and a small light in the button glows while it is pressed and goes out when it is released.
The dial of an electric stove burner is turned off, and the red-hot coil's glow dims.
The power button on a handheld game console is pressed, and the screen lights up with the start logo.
The switch on a wall-mounted heater is flipped, and its indicator light comes on and its fan starts.
A pair of hands claps twice in a room with a clap-activated lamp, and the lamp comes on.
A fluorescent tube in a garage is switched on, and it blinks a few times before staying lit.
A key on a toy piano is pressed, and the key lights up while it is held down and goes dark when it is released.
The wall button for an outdoor floodlight is pressed, and the yard lights up.
A shop escalator is started with its key switch, and the steps begin to move upward.
The button on a coffee machine is pressed, and a light comes on and coffee begins to drip into the cup.
The bedside lamp is switched off, and only the glow of the alarm clock's display remains in the dark room.
The plug of a lit table lamp is pulled out of the wall socket, and the lamp goes out.
A desk fan with its switch already on is plugged into a socket, and the blades start turning.
The plug of a television is pulled while a programme is playing, and the screen goes black.
The batteries are pulled out of a walking toy robot, and the robot stops mid-step.
A charging cable is plugged into a phone lying on a table, and a charging symbol appears on the screen.
An extension cord is yanked out of the wall socket, and the lamp, radio and heater plugged into it all go off together.
Grains of rice lie on the head of a snare drum; the drum is struck once with a stick and the grains jump.
A subwoofer is turned up in a living room, and a picture frame on the wall behind it slowly tilts askew with the bass.
A gong is struck once with a padded mallet, and a ping-pong ball hanging on a thread against its face is knocked away and swings.
A door slams in a hallway, and a set of keys hanging on a hook beside it swings and jingles.
A powerful motorcycle revs its engine at a kerb, and the leaves of a potted plant on the pavement beside it quiver.
A concert speaker stack blasts a bass note, and the fabric grille on its front visibly pulses in and out.
A wine glass half full of water is tapped on the rim with a spoon, and the water surface inside breaks into fine ripples while the glass rings.
A helicopter hovers low over a field, and the surface of a pond beneath it shivers into fine ripples.
A struck tuning fork is dipped into a glass of water, and the water sprays up where the prongs touch it.
A loud speaker plays a rising bass tone next to a tray of sand, and the sand grains jump and shift into patterns.
An excavator drops a load of rubble into a steel skip, and a nearby chain-link fence shivers along its length.
A phone on vibrate buzzes on a glass table, and a spoon lying next to it rattles against the glass.
Grains of rice lie on an upturned metal pot lid on a table; the lid is struck once with a spoon and the grains jump.
A train crosses a metal bridge, and the water in a puddle on the road below shows shivering rings.
A small scrap of paper rests on a bass string inside a grand piano with the lid open; the key for that string is pressed, and the paper jumps off the string.
A stadium crowd stamps in unison, and the beer in a cup on a railing shows a steady wobble in time with the stamps.
A few grains of salt lie on a xylophone bar; the bar is struck with a mallet and the grains jump off.
A speaker on the floor of a room plays a deep bass note, and a lit candle on the same floor flickers in time with the beats.
A large speaker's cone pumps in and out as a bass-heavy track plays, and it stops moving when the music is paused.
A phone set to vibrate buzzes on a wooden table and creeps slowly across the surface until the buzzing stops.
An electric toothbrush is switched on and left lying on a bathroom counter, and it buzzes and slowly turns in circles.
A struck tuning fork is brought up to a ping-pong ball hanging on a thread, and the ball is kicked away and swings.
A coin stands balanced on the hood of a car idling roughly, and it jitters and topples over.
Small paper riders sit on the strings of an acoustic guitar; the body of the guitar is tapped with a palm and the riders jump.
A small paper rider sits on the string of a cello; a bow is drawn across that string and the rider is thrown off.
A wind-up alarm clock rings, and its little hammer hammers between the two bells and the clock shivers on the table.
A hand-held massager is switched on and set on a bed, and it shudders and wanders across the sheet.
Salt is sprinkled on the bars of a marimba; a mallet runs across the bars and the salt jumps off each bar in turn.
A blender runs on a kitchen counter, and its base vibrates and inches slightly across the counter until it is switched off.
A washing machine on its spin cycle rocks and shudders on the floor, and it settles still as the drum slows to a stop.
A glass of water sits on top of a large subwoofer, and when the music starts the water's surface breaks into fine ripples.
A large bell in a tower is rung by a rope, and it swings back and forth with the clapper striking it on each swing.
A heavy truck rumbles past a house, and a teaspoon resting on a stack of plates by the window jiggles and chatters against the top plate.
A desk fan with a bent blade is switched on, and the whole fan wobbles visibly on its base as the blades spin.
Thunder rolls over a house, and a strip of paper taped to a loose window pane quivers with each rumble.
Sand is sprinkled on a cymbal and a violin bow is drawn along its edge, and the sand jumps and gathers into lines.
A washing machine spins up to full speed, and the bottle of detergent standing on top of it shakes and creeps toward the edge.
A generator runs on a building site, and its frame shakes and the loose bolts on it rattle until it is shut down.
A marching band's bass drum passes close to a shop window, and a paper sign taped to the inside of the glass quivers with each beat.
A subway train roars through a station, and a hanging sign on the platform trembles on its chains.
A speaker on a table plays a loud bass track, and a handful of grains of rice scattered on the table jump and dance around it.
Grains of rice lie on the head of a banjo; a string is plucked and the grains jump.
A jackhammer starts up on a street, and the coffee in cups on a café terrace table shows rings of tiny ripples.
A car with a booming stereo pulls up at a light, and the fuzzy dice hanging from its rear-view mirror jiggle with the bass.
A low-flying jet passes over a house, and a hanging light fitting in the hallway swings gently.
The figurine on a wind-up music box turns slower and slower as the spring runs down, and finally stops.
A charging cable is plugged into an electric car, and a light on the charging port comes on.
A flashlight lying on a table and pointed at a wall is switched on, and a bright spot appears on the wall.
The cord of a bedside lamp is pulled, and the lamp lights up.
The start button on a blender is pressed, and the blades spin and the contents whirl.
The switch on the underside of a remote-controlled toy car is flicked on, and its headlights light up.
The cord of a running hairdryer is pulled out of the socket, and the dryer falls silent and stops blowing.
Two batteries are slid into a flashlight whose switch is already on, and the light comes on as the cap is screwed down.
A hairdryer resting on a counter with ribbons tied to its nozzle is switched on, and the ribbons stream out in the airflow.
A power bank is connected to a phone by a cable, and a light on the power bank comes on and the phone shows it is charging.
A battery pack is clipped into a remote-control car, and the car's lights come on.
The knob of a desk fan is turned from off to high, and the blades spin up to speed.
The battery is unlatched from an e-bike, and the display on the handlebars goes dark.
A string of fairy lights is unplugged from the wall, and the whole string goes dark.
A blender with its button held down is plugged into a wall socket, and the blades start spinning.
The switch on a battery pack attached to a garland of lights is slid on, and the garland lights up.
A toaster is unplugged while its coils are glowing, and the coils fade and the lever pops up.
In a garden at dusk, the solar lights along the path flicker on one after another.
A camera's screen goes dark mid-recording as its battery runs out.
An electric kettle is lifted off its base while it is boiling, and the kettle's light goes off and the boiling quiets.
A toy train is placed on its track and the track's power pack switched on, and the train begins to run.
Jumper cables from a running car are clamped onto a dead car's battery, and the dead car's dashboard lights come on.
A lamp is plugged into a socket and the socket switched on at the wall, and the lamp lights.
A battery pack is clipped into a cordless drill and the trigger pulled, and the drill bit spins.
A nightlight is plugged into a low wall socket, and it begins to glow.
A power cut hits a kitchen, and the fridge hum stops, the oven clock goes blank and the ceiling light goes out all at once.
A digital alarm clock is unplugged, and its glowing display goes blank.
A battery-powered toy car slows and stops as its battery runs flat, and its headlights dim and go out.
An electric blanket is plugged in and switched on, and its small control light comes on.
A running sewing machine is unplugged, and the needle stops and its work light goes out.
An empty living room lit by a single lamp during a storm brightens for an instant as lightning flashes through the window.
Lightning flashes inside a bank of dark clouds over a city, and the clouds glow for a moment and then go dark.
An aquarium pump is plugged into the wall, and bubbles start rising from the air stone in the tank.
Several flashes of lightning light up a stormy sky over a highway one after another, each one lighting the wet road for an instant.
A lightning bolt strikes the sea beyond a beach at night, and the water and the wet sand flash bright and then go dark.
An electric lawnmower reaches the end of its cord and the plug pulls out of the socket, and the mower stops.
Heat lightning flickers silently on the horizon beyond a lake on a summer night, lighting the far clouds again and again.
A lightning bolt hits the metal rod on top of a tall building, and the rod and roof flash bright for an instant.
Lightning strikes a dry hillside, and after the flash a small patch of grass smoulders and smokes.
Lightning strikes a tall tree in a field, and the tree is lit brilliantly for a moment and then smoke rises from its top.
A dog lying in a hallway jumps up as a lightning flash lights the windows and the house shakes with thunder.
A lightning flash lights a bedroom through the curtains, and the shadow of the window frame appears on the wall for an instant.
Lightning flashes outside an empty parked car in a rainstorm, and the inside of the car lights up through the rain-streaked windows for an instant.
The top of a touch-sensitive lamp is tapped, and it lights up.
A lightning bolt strikes a lone tree on a golf course, and the tree's trunk splits with a shower of splinters.
Lightning flashes above a mountain hut in a snowstorm, and the falling snow is lit brightly for an instant.
A battery-powered lantern in a tent is switched on, and the tent lights up.
A jagged lightning bolt descends from a cloud to a hilltop, branching as it comes down.
Lightning flashes behind a lighthouse on a stormy coast, and the lighthouse is silhouetted while its own beam keeps sweeping.
A robotic welding arm touches down on a steel car body on an assembly line, and a shower of bright sparks bursts from the joint and falls to the floor.
The cord of a running vacuum cleaner snags on a doorframe and jerks out of the socket, and the vacuum stops.
An airliner flying through a storm cloud is hit by lightning, and a flash runs along its wing before the plane flies on.
The canvas of a pitched tent lights up from a lightning flash outside, then goes dark again.
A tram passes under a wire on a wet night, and its pole throws off blue-white sparks where it rubs the wire.
A portable generator at a campsite is started, and the string of lights connected to it comes on.
Lightning strikes a field of wind turbines, and one turbine's blade tip flashes brightly for an instant.
The second jumper-cable clamp is touched to a car battery terminal, and a spark jumps at the contact.
A glowing electric heater is unplugged, and the orange glow of its elements fades to dark.
A knife is pressed against a spinning sharpening wheel, and a stream of sparks flies off the blade's edge.
A lightning bolt forks into two branches before reaching the ground, both branches lighting up together.
A flint gas-lighter is clicked over a stove burner, and a spark jumps from its tip and the gas ignites.
A robot vacuum finishes cleaning and drives onto its charging dock, and a charging light on the dock comes on.
An overloaded power drill is run hard, and small sparks flicker through the vents on its motor housing.
A spinning angle grinder is pressed against a metal pipe clamped in a vise, and a fan of orange sparks streams off the wheel.
A subway train pulls out of a station, and a flash of sparks lights the tunnel where its shoe touches the rail.
A laptop charger is plugged into the wall and then into the laptop, and the small light on the charger connector comes on.
A power hammer in a forge pounds a red-hot steel bar, and tiny sparks fly off with each blow.
A moth flies into a hanging bug zapper on a porch, and there is a brief crackle and flash at the grid.
A bad connection in a fuse box sparks and pops, and the lights in the house go out.
A coin-cell battery is pressed into a wristwatch lying face up, and the second hand starts to tick.
A phone charger is plugged into a worn socket, and a small spark flashes at the plug as it goes in.
A frayed lamp cord is bumped, and a spark flashes at the bare spot and the lamp flickers.
A laptop is unplugged from its charger, and the charging light on it goes off while the screen stays on.

A limp balloon is stretched over the neck of an empty glass bottle, and the bottle is set in a bowl of hot water; the balloon begins to stand up and inflate.
Grey raw shrimp are dropped into a hot pan, and they curl and turn pink.
A layer of white sugar in a dry pan over heat melts from the edges into a clear liquid that turns amber and then deep brown.
A flat bag of microwave popcorn lies in a running microwave, and the bag swells and puffs up as popping begins inside.
An iron rod rests with one end buried in the glowing coals of a forge, and the buried end begins to glow dull red and brightens toward orange.
A cold egg is lowered into a pot of boiling water, and its shell cracks and a thread of white leaks out and sets into a pale wisp.
An inflated balloon drifts down onto a burning candle, and it bursts the instant the flame touches it.
Two rubber balls rolled toward each other across a gym floor meet off-centre and glance away from each other in new directions.
A heavy bowling ball is dropped onto the middle of a bed, the mattress dips under it, and it bounces slightly before settling.
The low string of an acoustic guitar is plucked, and the string blurs into a wide band before slowly sharpening to a line again.
A steel ruler is held flat on a desk with part sticking over the edge; the free end is flicked and it waggles up and down before coming to rest.
A taut rubber band stretched between two nails is flicked, and the band blurs and hums before going still.
A single string of an upright bass is plucked, and the thick string swings visibly from side to side before settling.
A large cymbal is struck, and the cymbal wobbles on its stand and its edge blurs before it steadies.
A thin sheet-metal door is knocked on, and the panel visibly flexes and rattles under the knocks before going quiet.
A long wooden fishing rod is tapped against a post, and the tip whips back and forth in a blur before settling.
The taut mat of a trampoline is slapped with a hand, and the mat ripples outward and shivers before going flat.
A stretched washing line is plucked, and the line blurs along its length and slowly sharpens.
A long steel saw blade is dropped flat onto a bench, and the blade twangs and flutters for a moment before lying still.
The top of a large empty cardboard box is thumped, and the lid panel bounces and quivers before settling.
A metal spring doorstop mounted on the wall is flicked, and it wobbles wildly and then slows to a stop.
The taut head of a large bass drum is slapped, and the head visibly dips and rebounds several times, each time smaller.
The wire of a garden fence is plucked, and the wire blurs and hums along its span before settling.
The thin elastic cord of a paddle ball toy is plucked, and the cord blurs and the ball bounces lightly before both go still.
A strip of thin sheet metal clamped at one end in a vise is flicked, and the free end vibrates in a blur that slowly stops.
The taut skin of a tambourine is struck, and the skin shivers and the metal jingles rattle before quieting.
A heavy door is slammed shut, and a picture frame on the nearby wall swings from side to side before hanging still.
A loud table saw in a workshop is switched on, and the screws in a jar on the bench begin to rattle and shift.
A hard rhythm is played on a drum kit in a small room, and a glass of water on a nearby amplifier ripples with each hit.
A heavy cast-iron pan is dropped onto a stovetop, and the lids of neighbouring pots rattle for a moment.
A chainsaw is revved in a garage, and the tools hanging on the pegboard behind it sway and tap against the board.
A lawnmower is started, and its handle shakes visibly until the engine is cut.
The pedal of a bass drum is pressed repeatedly, and the beater swings into the drumhead with each press and the head dips each time.
A pager on vibrate goes off on a nightstand and rattles against the wood until it stops.
The keys of a toy piano are banged, and the small hammers inside can be seen jumping up with each key press.
A paint shaker at a hardware store is switched on, and the paint can clamped in it blurs with the shaking until the timer stops it.
A dental drill is switched on and held up, and its tip becomes a blur until the pedal is released.
A stand mixer runs on high, and the whole mixer trembles on the counter until it is turned down.
A microphone on a stand is tapped, and the mic head jiggles on its clip with each tap.
